source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over each artifact role view (kit, build, stages, Eternal, lane augment, matchup verdicts, honesty notes) only; every number ground-checked, failing lines dropped

support.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash onto the target, then Royal Flourish to mesmerize and drop Queen's Garden so your carry finishes inside the thorns. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done by minute 19, cast Iron Rose early and stand in front longer.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn, Narbash and Phase win this lane on our sim; don't Lash in first, hold Queen's Garden for their engage.

offlane.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and close the gap, then Royal Flourish and Iron Rose to keep Thorns on them while you trade. Once Deathstalker lands around minute 16, take short fights on squishy targets and drop Queen's Garden to stop their escape.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our sim; against Greystone or Steel, farm under your tower instead of dashing in first.

offlane.line: Open with Web Lash to root, then Hellfire and Crushing Maw up close where it hits harder, and finish with Consume to pull them into the bite. Once Noxia finishes around minute 16, stay in longer fights and heal through them with Crushing Maw.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Aurora and Bayle win this lane on our sim; poke with Hellfire and skip all-ins until your jungler arrives.

jungle.line: Gank from terrain: Web Lash onto a wall, leap down on the target, then Consume to pull them into your bite and Crushing Maw to heal. After Noxia lands around minute 15, take longer skirmishes, since a hero kill makes you Awakened.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them in the jungle, fight beside your laners instead.

midlane.line: Open with Dread Nova to stun, drop Ether Crystal on them, then fire Particle Shredder so every hit stacks Disintegrate. Once Timewarp lands around minute 15, finish wounded targets with Synaptic Obliterator, whose beams hit harder on low-health enemies.
midlane.watchout: Every listed midlaner wins this lane on our sim; against Renna or Lt. Belica, clear waves from range and save Dread Nova for their engage.

support.line: Land Dread Nova to stun, then drop Ether Crystal to pull them together while Particle Shredder keeps Disintegrate stacking for your carry. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith finish around minute 19, stand closer and take hits meant for your carry.
support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our sim; hide behind minions and drop Ether Crystal on your carry to push divers off them.

offlane.line: Open with Glacial Charge, stop mid-dash with Hoarfrost to root them, then Boreal Sweep and basic attacks to raise your Frost Storm. After Wraith Leggings lands around minute 16, hold Cryoseism for the moment they try to walk out.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; don't dash in first, let him engage, root him with Hoarfrost and back off.

jungle.line: Gank with Glacial Charge, cancel into Hoarfrost to root, then Boreal Sweep and land Cryoseism while they are slowed. Once Orion finishes around minute 15, chain ganks across lanes; rooting heroes shortens your jump cooldown for the escape.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our sim; skip one-on-one fights with him and gank lanes or take objectives on the far side.

support.line: Walk your carry in on Glacial Charge's ice, root with Hoarfrost, then Boreal Sweep to slow and Cryoseism whoever they dive. Once Stonewall and Inquisition are done by minute 18, play in front and take hits for your carry.
support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our sim; don't trade into her, stay by your carry and root her with Hoarfrost when she engages.

offlane.line: Open with Skull Crusher to leap in and mark them, land all three Cursed Edge slashes for the stun and bleed, then Dire Howl to heal through the trade. Once Spear Of Desolation lands around minute 16, chase fleeing squishies down with Kingslayer.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; farm safely and don't leap in first unless your jungler is there.

jungle.line: Gank with Skull Crusher to mark and run them down, Cursed Edge for the stun, then Dire Howl to slow and heal back what you took. Once The Perforator and Spear Of Desolation are done by minute 16, catch running squishy carries with Kingslayer.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them in the jungle, gank lanes and take the camps they leave.

jungle.line: Mark a target with Detection Protocol, follow the trail in, Chrono Swipe through them, then Primeval Roar to fear and Ursine Burst to grab and slam them. After Deathstalker lands around minute 16, stick to squishy targets in short fights.
jungle.watchout: Most listed junglers, like Khaimera and Kwang, win this matchup on our sim; avoid jungle duels and gank lanes where Ursine Burst secures the kill.

midlane.line: Open with Eventide, then Shadow Slip in so the second hit applies Haemorrhage, spin Blade Siphon to heal, and Feast to finish. Once Orion lands around minute 15, hunt quick picks on squishy targets and swap back with Shadow Slip to escape.
midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane on our sim; don't dive him with Feast early, trade with Eventide and keep Shadow Slip ready to swap back.

offlane.line: Shadow Slip in, hit Eventide so Haemorrhage applies, then Blade Siphon to heal through the trade and swap back out before they answer. Once Orion finishes around minute 16, save Feast for targets already bleeding from Haemorrhage.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; don't commit Feast into him, poke with Eventide and keep the Shadow Slip swap for your escape.

jungle.line: Gank with Shadow Slip, follow with Eventide to apply Haemorrhage, then Feast the bleeding target for bonus damage and a big heal. After Orion lands around minute 15, chain picks across lanes and swap back with Shadow Slip to escape.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera is only an even matchup on our sim; don't take fair duels with him in his jungle, fight him near your laners.

offlane.line: Open with Forward Crunch to stun, then Left Crunch and Right Crunch to slow, weaving a basic attack after each to cut your cooldowns. Once Basilisk lands around minute 16, use Re-Crunch to repeat your empowered ability in short fights on squishies.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Aurora and Bayle win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only dash in when your jungler is coming.

jungle.line: Gank with Forward Crunch to stun, then Right Crunch to slow and Left Crunch to hit hard, with a basic attack between each to lower cooldowns. After Basilisk lands around minute 16, use Re-Crunch right after your strongest hit to repeat it.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; skip jungle duels with them and gank lanes or take objectives elsewhere.

support.line: Throw Stasis Bomb from long range for a longer stun, then Photon Disruptor to slow, and trap them with Containment Fence so Ion Strike lands. Once Stonewall and Inquisition finish by minute 18, stand in front and soak hits for your carry.
support.watchout: You beat every listed support on our sim, but a missed Stasis Bomb leaves you open; back off and wait for it instead of forcing.

carry.line: Open with Old Rusty to slow, throw Gag Grenade to silence them, then Rad Rounds for fast basic attacks and Shrapnel Cannon to shred armor. Once Deathstalker lands around minute 16, keep attacking in longer fights and fire Shrapnel Cannon mid-air to escape dives.
carry.watchout: Murdock wins this lane on our sim; don't trade inside his range, farm safely and save Shrapnel Cannon's mid-air launch for his engage.

carry.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance, then Zero Shift to melee, Talon Drive in and spin Axiom Strike to build Heat for Limit Break. Once Viper lands around minute 16, stay in longer fights, since melee stance heals you off hero damage.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock and Drongo win this lane on our sim; stay ranged, farm safely and only go melee after your support lands crowd control.

offlane.line: Trade in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and Sidewind, then Zero Shift to melee and Talon Drive in once they're low, keeping damage flowing to build Heat. After Viper lands around minute 16, take longer fights in melee stance to heal off hero damage.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our sim; stay in ranged stance, farm safely and only go melee with your jungler nearby.

jungle.line: Gank with Reaping Dash, Hamstring a lone target for bonus damage and the slow, then Earth Shatter to execute and recast on the next one. Once Augmentation lands around minute 16, dive into fights, since each takedown nearly resets Reaping Dash.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them, gank lanes and save Safeguard to block their key ability.

offlane.line: Raise Safeguard to block their poke, then Reaping Dash in and Hamstring a lone target, finishing with Earth Shatter's execute. Once Augmentation lands around minute 16, chase kills, since each takedown cuts Reaping Dash's cooldown sharply.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Aurora and Bayle win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only dash in when your jungler is coming.

midlane.line: Land a Sticky Mine and basic attack to empower it, then send Seek and Destroy and root them with Security Gate. Once Wraith Leggings lands around minute 15, trap groups inside Tesla Dome and hold them there with Security Gate.
midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane on our sim; farm from max range and save Security Gate to root him when he engages.

midlane.line: Open with Void Breach to slow, drop Cosmic Rift on them, then basic attack to tether and root, and cast Black Hole once they're stuck. Once Orion finishes around minute 15, use Torn Space to reach a good Black Hole spot in team fights.
midlane.watchout: You beat every listed midlaner on our sim, but Black Hole locks you in a channel; cast it behind your frontline, never as the opener.

offlane.line: Leap in with Assault The Gates, spin Make Way to shred armor, slow with Sacred Oath, then Stone Forged Soul to heal before crashing down. Once Deathstalker lands around minute 16, push your lead with short fights on squishy targets.
offlane.watchout: You beat every listed offlaner on our sim, but a missed Assault The Gates leaves you stranded; leap only when your follow-up is ready.

jungle.line: Gank with Assault The Gates, spin Make Way to shred armor, slow with Sacred Oath, and save Stone Forged Soul to heal and crash down. Once Basilisk lands around minute 16, hit squishy targets in short fights.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our sim; don't duel him in the jungle, gank lanes or take objectives on the far side.

carry.line: Raise Energy Shield to block their opener, then Assault Mode for long-range basic attacks, Displacement Blast to push divers away, and GTFO to finish fleeing targets. Once Deathstalker lands around minute 16, keep hitting from max range in longer fights.
carry.watchout: Murdock is only even on our sim; don't trade into him without your support, and save Energy Shield for his key ability.

offlane.line: Pull them in with Smash 'n Grab, cleave with Double Pain to heal, then Warlord's Challenge to stun and keep basic attacking so Bloodlust stacks. Once Solaris lands around minute 16, chase with Stampede in short fights on squishies.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Aurora and Bayle win this lane on our sim; farm safely, heal with Double Pain and wait for your jungler to engage.

jungle.line: Gank with Stampede to drag them, Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, then Warlord's Challenge and basic attacks to stack Bloodlust. Once Solaris lands around minute 16, take short fights on squishy targets and heal with Double Pain.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them in the jungle, gank lanes and trade objectives instead.

midlane.line: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades to slow, drop a Land Mine to stun, then charge R2000 Missile and finish with Make It Rain. Once Oathkeeper and Spirit Of Amir finish by minute 15, poke from long range and save Land Mine to knock divers away.
midlane.watchout: Gideon is only even on our sim; don't trade up close, poke from range and keep Land Mine to blast yourself out of danger.

midlane.line: Set Flame Turret near the wave, basic attack to apply Slick, then roll Oil Spill and ignite it with Molotov so they burn. Once Soulbinder lands around minute 15, save Inferno for when they walk into your turrets, belching to knock divers away.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and The Fey win this lane on our sim; play behind your turrets and don't push past them without your jungler.

offlane.line: Plant Flame Turret where you farm, roll Oil Spill and ignite it with Molotov, and keep basic attacks on them for Slick. Once Wraith Leggings lands around minute 16, fight inside your turret range and finish with Inferno.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; fight beside your turrets, never away from them, and save Inferno's knockback for his dive.

carry.line: Land Narcosis to suspend them, drop Hydroclasm on top and pop it with Brine once it amplifies, then Genesis to knock them up. Once Wraith Leggings lands around minute 16, use your lane lead to push and poke from range.
carry.watchout: You beat every listed carry on our sim, but a missed Narcosis leaves you open to divers; back off until it's ready again.

midlane.line: Throw Narcosis to suspend them, place Hydroclasm under them and pop it with Brine after it amplifies, then fire Genesis through walls to finish. Once Wraith Leggings lands around minute 16, last-hit with Brine for bonus gold and roam.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our sim; farm with Brine from range and save Narcosis for their engage.

jungle.line: Approach in Shadow Walk, open with Crippling Dagger to apply Death Mark, then Shadow Dance onto the marked target for double damage and Guillotine to finish. Once Spear Of Desolation lands around minute 15, hunt squishy carries caught alone.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; never duel them head-on, gank lanes and pick off isolated targets instead.

jungle.line: Gank with Ambush to leap in and slow, then Unleash for fast attacks and Cull to stun, saving Invigorate to cleanse their stuns and roots. Once Deathstalker lands around minute 16, keep fighting so your Rage keeps cooldowns rolling.
jungle.watchout: Kwang is only even on our sim; don't start a fair duel with him, gank lanes or fight him with a laner beside you.

offlane.line: Ambush onto them once they're low for extra damage, Unleash for fast cleaving attacks, then Cull to stun, keeping Invigorate to cleanse their stuns. Once Spear Of Desolation lands around minute 16, take short fights on squishy targets.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only Ambush when your jungler is close.

carry.line: Stack Vengeance with basic attacks and Mercy, then Dusk to pop the stacks and slow, keeping Shadow Glide to dodge or chase. Once Deathstalker lands around minute 16, use Purge in fights to cut enemy healing while you shred them.
carry.watchout: You beat every listed carry on our sim, but Purge slows you and blocks other abilities; keep Shadow Glide ready before committing.

jungle.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, dash through with Surge of the Heavens to knock them up, then Fury of the Heavens to slow. Once Prophecy finishes around minute 15, weave basic attacks between abilities while your Blade is Energized.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera is only even on our sim; don't duel him in his jungle, gank lanes and fight him beside your laners.

offlane.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether, use Light of the Heavens for the shield, then Surge of the Heavens back to the Blade for the knock-up. Once Prophecy lands around minute 16, trade longer with Energized basic attacks.
offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; don't trade into him early, farm safely and fight only when your jungler arrives.

carry.line: Fire Saturation Charge to slow, then follow with basic attacks and an Orbital Sanction they can't walk out of, keeping Frag Order to launch yourself away. Once Spectra lands around minute 15, drop Rally Point in fights to heal and speed your team.
carry.watchout: Every listed carry wins this lane on our sim; farm safely, keep Frag Order ready to escape, and let your support start fights.

midlane.line: Place Void Drone near them, open with Seismic Assault to stun, drop Void Bomb on the stunned target, then finish with Neural Disruptor once their mana is drained. Once Soulbinder lands around minute 15, look for picks on squishy targets.
midlane.watchout: Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey win this lane on our sim; farm from range and save Seismic Assault for their engage.

support.line: Open with Q Seismic Assault to stun them, drop RMB Void Bomb on the stunned target, then finish with R Neural Disruptor. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done around minute 19, you can stand in front and soak hits while your stuns land.
support.watchout: Against Dekker this lane loses on paper; drop Void Drone for vision, stay behind your carry, and save Seismic Assault to stop whoever dives.

support.line: Throw RMB Maco Sparkle from long range so the stun lasts longer, follow with E Maco Fly to slow and shield yourself, and save Q Maco Gift for your carry. Once Noxia and Oblivion Crown are done around minute 19, heal harder through fights.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker or Narbash, don't leap in first with Maco Fly; stay back, heal your carry and stun whoever dives.

midlane.line: Mark your target with RMB, slow them with Q Hive, run through them with E Swarm to stack Pestilence, then finish with R Curse on the marked target. Once Spectral Schematics and Orion are done around minute 15, take longer trades.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon this lane loses on paper; farm with Hive from range and save Swarm to escape instead of diving in.

support.line: Pull a target in with RMB Abduct, then hold E Beguile to mesmerize them, and drop Q Contagion so your carry heals and gets tougher. Once Noxia and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 19, your heals carry longer fights.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker or Narbash, don't channel Abduct out in the open; stay behind your carry and use Beguile to stop divers.

carry.line: Set Static Trap where they walk, poke with basic attacks until Shots Fired is ready, then blast with RMB Buckshot and chase with E Hot Pursuit. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, stand and trade basic attacks longer.
carry.watchout: Kneeling for Long Arm of the Law with nobody in front gets you killed; fire it from behind your team.

offlane.line: Set Static Trap at your feet, poke with basic attacks until Shots Fired is ready, and push divers off you with RMB Buckshot. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, stand and trade basic attacks longer.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora, don't trade up close; trap the lane, farm near your tower and Buckshot them away.

support.line: Fully charge RMB Serenity to stun, drop Q Consecrated Ground under your carry, and throw E Alacrity to shield them, saving R Reversal Of Fortune to save an ally anywhere. Once Oblivion Crown and Lunaria are done around minute 18, your shields hit harder.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker or Narbash, don't stand in front charging Serenity; stay behind your carry and shield first.

support.line: Stun with RMB Thunk, use Q March! to rush your team in or out, then start R Crash Bang Boom! in the middle of the fight. Once Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown are done around minute 20, you can stay in fights longer.
support.watchout: Against Riktor or Dekker this lane loses on paper; keep Thunk to stop their engage instead of opening with it.

midlane.line: Slow them with E Data Burst, send Q L.I.N.X through them, then dash with RMB Erase Vector for an empowered Jolt; after three abilities, your next one gets Overclocked. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, chain R Final Thread into its recast bomb.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon or Iggy & Scorch this lane loses on paper; farm from range and save Erase Vector to dash away.

support.line: Link your carry with RMB Telekinetic Link, blind them with Q Psychic Flare, root with E Energy Lance, then pop R Hyperflux so you both hit faster. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done around minute 19, you can take more hits for your carry.
support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker, Mourn or Narbash, stay behind your carry and reactivate Telekinetic Link to pull them out before they get stunned or rooted.

jungle.line: Carry Q Boulder Throw into a gank, throw it to stun, then RMB Pounce in and E Rumble to keep them slowed. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done around minute 15, pop R Behemoth to throw boulders instantly and stay in fights.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; skip their camps, gank lanes instead, and fight only with a teammate beside you.

midlane.line: Open with E Stupor to mesmerize, drop Q Mortal Coil on them, then fire RMB Soulfire while you walk over Essence to power up. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, use R Abyssal Rift to jump into fights.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey all beat this lane on paper; farm from range and hold Stupor for whoever dives you.

carry.line: Land E Scar first, then basic attack to burn the marks into a root, and fire Q Obliterate since its missiles chase the marked target. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, use R Reckoning to pull one target away and duel them.
carry.watchout: Most carry matchups here lose on paper; don't trade early, farm safely behind your support and wait for your items before using Reckoning.

support.line: Hook a target with RMB Riplash, silence them with Q Shock Therapy, and turn on E Electrocute while your carry hits them; save R Skewer to hold several enemies. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done around minute 19, you can walk in first.
support.watchout: Against Dekker this lane loses on paper; don't throw Riplash blindly, stay near your carry and use Shock Therapy to stop her engage.

jungle.line: Pull a target with RMB Riplash, silence with Q Shock Therapy, then keep basic attacking with E Electrocute on; use R Skewer to hold the group. Once Spectra and Prophecy are done around minute 15, your basic attacks carry longer fights.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; avoid their camps, gank lanes instead, and fight only with a teammate nearby.

offlane.line: Dash in with E First Intent for the shield, swing Q Ashen Vow so the outer edge slows them, then finish low targets with RMB Minueta. Once Augmentation and Viper are done around minute 16, open with R Swan Song to lock one target.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and keep First Intent to escape instead of diving.

jungle.line: Dash in with E First Intent for the shield, swing Q Ashen Vow so the outer edge slows them, then finish low targets with RMB Minueta. Once Augmentation and Viper are done around minute 16, open ganks with R Swan Song to lock one target.
jungle.watchout: Against Kwang this jungle loses on paper; don't duel him in his camps, gank lanes instead and fight with a teammate beside you.

jungle.line: Dive in with E Ascend, clap RMB Chastise to slow, then Q Heaven's Fury to strike and reposition; pop R Heresy when the fight starts. After a takedown, touch the visage for a free Heresy, especially once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, Kwang or Feng Mao this jungle loses on paper; avoid solo duels in their jungle and gank lanes with help instead.

offlane.line: Dive in with E Ascend, clap RMB Chastise to slow, then Q Heaven's Fury to strike and reposition; pop R Heresy for the fight. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, chain takedowns by touching the visage for free Heresy.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup beats this pick on paper; farm near your tower and only dive with Ascend when your jungler arrives.

offlane.line: Dash through them with RMB Phantom Rush to fear, drop E Subjugate to chain them in place, then Q Siphon to steal health. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done around minute 16, finish fights with R Colossal Blow.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Aurora or Bayle this lane loses on paper; farm with Siphon near your tower and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Gank with RMB Phantom Rush to fear, drop E Subjugate to chain them in place, then Q Siphon to steal health. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done around minute 15, use R Colossal Blow to knock divers away or finish fights.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; avoid their camps, gank lanes instead and fight only with a teammate nearby.

offlane.line: Dash in with RMB Rushing Beat, send Q Line Tempo through them, and cast E Circle Rhythm for the shield; every ability hit builds Track toward R All-Kill. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done around minute 16, cast All-Kill on every marked enemy.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel or Scarlett this lane loses on paper; farm with Line Tempo from range and keep a Rushing Beat charge to escape.

jungle.line: Gank with RMB Rushing Beat, send Q Line Tempo through them, and cast E Circle Rhythm for the shield; every ability hit builds Track toward R All-Kill. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp are done around minute 15, finish marked enemies with All-Kill.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; skip their camps, gank lanes instead and keep a Rushing Beat charge to escape.

carry.line: Slow them with Q Plasma Grenade, lift off with E Air Assault for extra range, then turn on RMB Hypercharge and keep shooting; finish low targets with R Atomiser. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, stay in longer trades.
carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock and Drongo beat this lane on paper; farm behind your support and save Air Assault to dodge their trades.

carry.line: Slow them with Q Hail of Arrows, keep basic attacking to stack Relentless, then fire RMB Piercing Shot; use E Heightened Senses to reset a bad trade. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, open fights with R Inner Fire.
carry.watchout: Against Murdock or Drongo this lane loses on paper; farm with Piercing Shot from range and keep Heightened Senses to escape.

offlane.line: Charge in with Q Bull Rush, stun with RMB Shield Bash, and drop E Force Shield to block their shots while you trade. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, jump in with R Shield Slam to stun the group.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and save Bull Rush to escape instead of engaging.

support.line: Charge in with Q Bull Rush, stun with RMB Shield Bash, and drop E Force Shield to block shots aimed at your carry. Once Stonewall and Vainglory are done around minute 19, open fights with R Shield Slam and soak the hits.
support.watchout: Against Dekker this lane loses on paper; stay beside your carry and keep Force Shield up for them instead of rushing in.

offlane.line: Throw E Highland Hurl to slow, spin Q Ruthless Assault, and basic attack to fill Hersir so your next ability is empowered; use RMB Wild Rush to chase. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, pop R Unstoppable Force to dive under towers.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora beat this lane on paper; farm near your tower, where Terra gets tougher, and wait for your jungler.

jungle.line: Gank with RMB Wild Rush, throw E Highland Hurl to slow, spin Q Ruthless Assault, and basic attack to fill Hersir for an empowered ability. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, pop R Unstoppable Force to dive under towers.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera or Kwang this jungle loses on paper; avoid their camps, gank lanes instead and fight only with a teammate nearby.

midlane.line: Throw E Harvest Nettles at the same target again and again, drop Q Bramble Patch to slow them, then land RMB Untamed Growth on top. Once Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 16, pull the group with R Fly Trap.
midlane.watchout: Against Gideon this lane loses on paper; farm from range with Harvest Nettles and keep Bramble Patch between you and him.

support.line: Poke one target with E Harvest Nettles, drop Q Bramble Patch to slow anyone diving your carry, and land RMB Untamed Growth on slowed enemies. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith are done around minute 19, step forward and start fights with R Fly Trap.
support.watchout: Before your tank items land you are fragile; if you wander ahead of your carry you get caught alone and killed, so stay with them and poke.

carry.line: Slow them with RMB Vortex Grenade, fire Q Vaporize, then basic attack right after each ability for the triple shot; every hit shortens E Rocket Dash. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, unload R Ventilate in longer fights.
carry.watchout: Against Murdock or Drongo this lane loses on paper; farm behind your support and keep Rocket Dash ready to escape their trades.

midlane.line: Hit them with E Bloodbound for attack speed, bind them with RMB Arterial Grip, then keep basic attacking so Lilith keeps striking; add Q Rupture. Once Spectral Schematics and Wraith Leggings are done around minute 16, use R Exsanguinate to heal through longer fights.
midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey beat this lane on paper; farm from range and bind only with your jungler nearby.

carry.line: Throw Q Peekaboo! to slow and mark them, then fire RMB Knock, Knock! at the marked target and keep basic attacking. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, trade longer and use R Back It Up! to drag a fleeing enemy back.
carry.watchout: Against Murdock or Drongo this lane loses on paper; farm with Knock, Knock! from range and keep Surprise, Surprise! to escape.

midlane.line: Throw Q Peekaboo! to slow and mark them, then fire RMB Knock, Knock! at the marked target and keep basic attacking. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, use R Back It Up! to drag a fleeing enemy back into your team.
midlane.watchout: Nearly every listed mid matchup beats this pick on paper; farm with Knock, Knock! from range and keep Surprise, Surprise! ready to escape.

jungle.line: Dash in with RMB Windsurge in Spirit stance, throw E Cyclebreaker to stun, then switch stance with R and keep basic attacking to spawn Clones. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, use Q Pole Vault in Body stance to leap onto the enemy damage dealers standing at the back.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, Kwang or Feng Mao this jungle loses on paper; avoid solo duels in their camps and gank lanes with a teammate instead.

jungle.line: Pull in with Q Lash Kick to slow them, basic attack to stack Rising Storm, and turn on E Windburn for reach; RMB Backlash reflects incoming shots. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, pop R Quelling Gale to block projectiles.
jungle.watchout: Every listed jungle matchup beats this pick on paper; never duel the enemy jungler alone, gank lanes with your teammates instead.

jungle.line: Fire RMB Whispering Echoes to apply Soul Rip, rush through them with E Severance to reset it, then spin Q Anima Burst to heal. Once Viper and Solaris are done around minute 16, channel R Soulstorm to pull the group in and reset Severance.
jungle.watchout: Against Khaimera, Kwang or Feng Mao this jungle loses on paper; avoid solo duels in their camps and gank lanes with a teammate instead.

offlane.line: Raise Q Barricade to block their trade, swing it to stun, then thrust RMB Spear of Nyr and chase with E Evade. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done around minute 16, leap onto a low target with R Coliseum to finish them.
offlane.watchout: Against Greystone or Steel this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and save Barricade to block their engage.

jungle.line: Raise Q Barricade to block damage, swing it to stun, then thrust RMB Spear of Nyr and chase with E Evade. Once Viper and Spear Of Desolation are done around minute 15, leap onto a low target with R Coliseum to finish them.
jungle.watchout: Leaping in with Coliseum before your team arrives gets you surrounded and killed; wait for a teammate and keep Evade to escape.

support.line: Stun with Q Ricochet, slow with E Bad Medicine, and keep RMB Infuse on your carry; cast R Neural Regenesis on them before a fight turns. Once Oblivion Crown and Lifecore are done around minute 19, your heals carry longer fights.
support.watchout: Every listed support matchup beats this pick on paper; stay behind your carry, heal instead of trading, and save Ricochet for divers.

offlane.line: Poke with basic attacks to stack their poison, stun with Q Ricochet, and drop E Bad Medicine to slow them while you keep hitting. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, start longer trades with your jungler nearby.
offlane.watchout: Every listed offlane matchup beats this pick on paper; farm near your tower and save Ricochet to stop whoever dives you.

midlane.line: Poke with basic attacks to stack their poison, stun with Q Ricochet, and drop E Bad Medicine to slow them while you keep hitting. Once Spectral Schematics and Oathkeeper are done around minute 16, join fights and heal allies with RMB Infuse.
midlane.watchout: Every listed mid matchup beats this pick on paper; farm from range and save Ricochet to stop whoever dives you.
